leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the order property to flex items to rearrange their visual sequence
Configure multiple flex items with different order values to create custom layouts
Manipulate the default order of flex items to override the source order
Integrate the order property with other flexbox properties for responsive designs
Construct a flex container where items are visually reordered without changing HTML structure
Update the visual hierarchy of elements using positive, negative, and zero order values
Control the stacking of flex items when order values are equal
